{"code": "
import os, re, json, csv, glob
import openpyxl
from collections import defaultdict

ROOT = "/online1/ycsc_chenkh/hitici_07/deepseek-harness/attached_files/task_10"

# ---- 1. Parse all .json records (rich structure) ----
records = {}
for p in sorted(glob.glob(ROOT + "/**/*.json", recursive=True)):
    with open(p) as f:
        d = json.load(f)
    d["_path"] = p
    d["_folder"] = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(p))
    records[d["record_id"]] = d

print("JSON records parsed:", len(records))

# ---- 2. Parse .md records to capture their control fields (records not in json set) ----
md_recs = {}
for p in sorted(glob.glob(ROOT + "/**/*.md", recursive=True)):
    txt = open(p).read()
    def g(label):
        m = re.search(r"\| %s \| (.*?) \|" % re.escape(label), txt)
        return m.group(1) if m else None
    rid = txt.split("RECORD: ")[-1][:20] if "RECORD: " in txt else None
    m = re.search(r"RECORD:\s*(CB-DOC-\d+-\d+)", txt)
    if m:
        md_recs[m.group(1)] = {
            "matter": g("Matter"), "portfolio_key": g("Portfolio key"),
            "evidence_role": g("Evidence role"), "entity": g("Immutable entity"),
            "ref_rev": g("Referenced revision"), "cur_rev": g("Current revision"),
            "custodian": g("Custodian"), "reviewer": g("Reviewer"),
            "path": p, "folder": os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(p)),
            "title": txt.split("\n")[0].lstrip("# ").strip(),
        }
print("MD records parsed:", len(md_recs))

# ---- 3. Parse .txt records ----
txt_recs = {}
for p in sorted(glob.glob(ROOT + "/**/*.txt", recursive=True)):
    t = open(p).read()
    def g2(label):
        m = re.search(r"^%s:\s*(.*)$" % re.escape(label), t, re.M)
        return m.group(1).strip() if m else None
    m = re.search(r"RECORD:\s*(CB-DOC-\d+-\d+)", t)
    if m:
        txt_recs[m.group(1)] = {
            "portfolio_key": g2("PORTFOLIO KEY"), "evidence_role": g2("EVIDENCE ROLE"),
            "entity": g2("ENTITY KEY"), "ref_rev": g2("REFERENCED REVISION"),
            "cur_rev": g2("CURRENT REVISION"), "custodian": g2("CUSTODIAN"), "reviewer": g2("REVIEWER"),
            "path": p, "folder": os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(p)),
            "title": t.split("\n")[2].strip() if len(t.split("\n"))>2 else None,
        }
print("TXT records parsed:", len(txt_recs))

# ---- 4. Parse .csv records (metadata rows) ----
csv_recs = {}
for p in sorted(glob.glob(ROOT + "/**/*.csv", recursive=True)):
    with open(p) as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    meta = {r["key"]: r["value"] for r in rows if r.get("row_type")=="metadata"}
    src_rows = [r for r in rows if r.get("row_type")=="source_row"]
    chron = [r for r in rows if r.get("row_type")=="chronology"]
    rid = rows[0]["record_id"] if rows else None
    csv_recs[rid] = {"meta": meta, "src_rows": src_rows, "chron": chron, "path": p,
                     "folder": os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(p))}
print("CSV records parsed:", len(csv_recs))

all_ids = sorted(set(list(records.keys()) + list(md_recs.keys()) + list(txt_recs.keys()) + list(csv_recs.keys())))
print("TOTAL distinct record ids:", len(all_ids))
print("IDs:", all_ids[:5], "...", all_ids[-5:])
json.dump(sorted(all_ids), open("/tmp/all_ids.json","w"))
"}

import re, zlib, glob, json

def pdf_text(path):
    raw = open(path,'rb').read()
    texts = []
    # find all stream objects
    for m in re.finditer(rb"stream\r?\n(.*?)endstream", raw, re.S):
        data = m.group(1)
        try:
            data = zlib.decompress(data)
        except Exception:
            pass
        # extract text in parentheses (PDF Tj operators) 
        for tm in re.finditer(rb"\((?:\\.|[^\\()])*\)\s*Tj", data):
            s = tm.group(0)
            s = s[:s.rfind(b")")]
            s = s[s.find(b"(")+1:]
            texts.append(s.decode('latin-1'))
        # TJ arrays
        for tm in re.finditer(rb"\[(?:[^\[\]]|\\.)*\]\s*TJ", data):
            arr = tm.group(0)
            parts = re.findall(rb"\((?:\\.|[^\\()])*\)", arr)
            line = "".join(p[1:-1].decode('latin-1') for p in parts)
            texts.append(line)
    # unescape
    out = []
    for t in texts:
        t = t.replace("\\(", "(").replace("\\)", ")").replace("\\\\","\\")
        out.append(t)
    return out

ROOT = "/online1/ycsc_chenkh/hitici_07/deepseek-harness/attached_files/task_10"
pdfs = sorted(glob.glob(ROOT+"/**/*.pdf", recursive=True))
pdftxt = {}
for p in pdfs:
    lines = pdf_text(p)
    pdftxt[p] = lines
    print("="*60)
    print(p.split("task_10/")[1], "lines:", len(lines))
    for l in lines[:30]:
        print("  ", l)
json.dump(pdftxt, open("/tmp/pdfs.json","w"))
"}

def pdf_text(path):
    raw=open(path,'rb').read(); texts=[]
    for m in re.finditer(rb"stream\r?\n(.*?)endstream", raw, re.S):
        data=m.group(1)
        try: data=zlib.decompress(data)
        except Exception: pass
        for tm in re.finditer(rb"\((?:\\.|[^\\()])*\)\s*Tj", data):
            s=tm.group(0); s=s[:s.rfind(b")")]; s=s[s.find(b"(")+1:]; texts.append(s.decode('latin-1'))
        for tm in re.finditer(rb"\[(?:[^\[\]]|\\.)*\]\s*TJ", data):
            parts=re.findall(rb"\((?:\\.|[^\\()])*\)", tm.group(0))
            texts.append("".join(p[1:-1].decode('latin-1') for p in parts))
    return "\n".join(t.replace("\\(","(").replace("\\)",")") for t in texts)

{"content": "# Working Position — CB-LD-2701 Aurora pricing MDL discovery audit

**To:** Litigation team, *In re Residential Fixture Pricing* (matter CB-LD-2701)

def pdf_text(path):
    raw=open(path,'rb').read(); texts=[]
    for m in re.finditer(rb"stream\r?\n(.*?)endstream", raw, re.S):
        data=m.group(1)
        try: data=zlib.decompress(data)
        except Exception: pass
        for tm in re.finditer(rb"\((?:\\.|[^\\()])*\)\s*Tj", data):
            s=tm.group(0); s=s[:s.rfind(b")")]; s=s[s.find(b"(")+1:]; texts.append(s.decode('latin-1'))
        for tm in re.finditer(rb"\[(?:[^\[\]]|\\.)*\]\s*TJ", data):
            parts=re.findall(rb"\((?:\\.|[^\\()])*\)", tm.group(0))
            texts.append("".join(p[1:-1].decode('latin-1') for p in parts))
    return "\n".join(t.replace("\\(","(").replace("\\)",")") for t in texts)
